Exact Casma recovery must therefore be gated by the nine documented N7 codes, names, areas and returned geometries rather than a national feature-count assertion.

public_repository_bitstream_inventory.inference_limit: The absence of a vector bitstream in the public repository record does not prove that Uh_pfas100 is lost or non-public elsewhere.

acceptance_rule: Prefer exact original Uh_pfas100 bytes if a reproducible institutional download is found.
Otherwise accept an institutional descendant only after exact per-code queries for 1375961-1375969 pass identity, area and geometry checks and raw bytes plus SHA-256 are frozen.
Never infer the nine polygons from PDF map graphics.
